body.x: Rifft participated in the “CES 2018 Unveiled” which opened on Sunday, January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to present a large-scale wireless charger, “Wi Surf.”

A French enterprise, Rifft designs and produces products which change our everyday lives. Rifft tries to lead the high technology markets with its distinctive inventions developed though creative critical thinking. With its “Wi Surf” presented this time, Riff was awarded the 2018 Innovation Award in the sections of Smart Homes and Smart Energy.

Wi Surf is a consumer-adjustable inductive charger of wireless module as well as a power supply station. It is a large-scale charger which consists of smaller wireless charging devices which can be assembled into furniture in such a way as puzzles are assembled. You can charge various kinds of home electronics by simply putting them onto the assembled furniture.

Wi Surf can be applied to all kinds of surface such as wood, glass, plastic, leather, etc. The consumer can directly choose the size, the color, the texture, and the finishing material of this product in order to match it to the interior of the room. Being Qi certified, this product is compatible with all the low-voltage electric devices such as LED lamps, smartphones, tablets, headphones, toys, etc.

CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
